messages:
amanda_pm: quick triage  ACMEHealth pressed for console visibility before GA. They want dashboard templates, per-route cost breakdown, and tracing hooks for error flows. Need plan for next sprint.

raj_engineer: dashboards + cost = frontend + data work. Tracing hooks hit runtime—riskier. Recommend we split.

ellie_sre: if we do tracing, make it error-only and feature-flagged. Define perf gate first.

lucy_csm: ACME can accept error-only as interim if dashboards + cost land fast. They want trace links to dashboard incidents.

jordan_data: cost attribution plan: attribute cost = gpu_ms * token_count per request, group by org+route. I'll prototype SQL.

amanda_pm: plan proposal: ship dashboards + cost in sprint; tracing error-only as beta behind flag with canary. Owners: Jordan cost, Raj tracing, Ellie perf gates.

raj_engineer: will write RFC for tracing beta and perf tests.

ellie_sre: will schedule a 10% canary and add rollback triggers: p50 delta >10ms or CPU +5%.

lucy_csm: I'll confirm ACME signoff on interim plan today.

amanda_pm: ok, owners open tickets and tag `#planning`. Reconvene after RFC + SQL prototype.
